# What the slow simulations (pnpm test:sim, files named *.sim.test.ts) depend on: one git pathspec per
# line, a directory ending in "/". On a branch, CI's Simulations job runs only when the branch changes
# one of these compared with where it left main (scripts/simulations-needed.sh); it always runs on
# pushes to main, nightly, and on manual dispatch.
#
# lib/analytics/simulation-inputs.test.ts follows the imports of every simulation file and of
# vitest.sim.config.mts, and fails if one of them isn't covered here or a listed path doesn't exist.

# The simulations and the code they import.
lib/analytics/
lib/format.ts
lib/market-data/session.ts
lib/market-data/types.ts

# How Vitest runs them.
vitest.sim.config.mts
vitest.shared.ts
tsconfig.json

# Dependencies, Node.js and pnpm versions, and scripts. package.json counts unless the only change
# is its "version", so a release's version bump doesn't run the simulations.
package.json
pnpm-lock.yaml

# The job, this list, and the decision.
.github/workflows/ci.yml
.github/simulation-inputs.txt
scripts/simulations-needed.sh
